Steel is the backbone of Arcforge. It takes two multiblocks.
# 1. Coal coke
Build a Carbonizer and bake coal (or carbon dust) into coal coke. It needs no fuel, just time. Coal gives creosote as a by-product.
# 2. Steel
Build the Arcforge Furnace. For a cold start, put one Iron Ingot in the first input and two Coal Coke in the coke slot. One coke starts heating; the other is consumed by the steel recipe. Leave both additive slots empty. The Furnace must reach 1,200°C and be formed; each smelt makes a Steel Ingot and Slag. Its screen shows how many coke are present and how many are needed.
The same furnace makes the tier alloys later on. See the Steelmaking chapter.
